title: Follow-up to #3: Updated epoch-38 vector checkpoint yields 55.45 mAP after key remapping
body:
Hi @Ethan-Zheng136 @ZZongzheng0918,

Thank you for locating and releasing the epoch-38 checkpoint.

I am opening this follow-up issue because [[#3](https://github.com/Ethan-Zheng136/UMPE/issues/3)] is now closed, and I encountered some additional concerns while evaluating the updated checkpoint.

Using the same environment, configuration, and released nuScenes priors, I obtained:

| Checkpoint | Divider AP | Pedestrian crossing AP | Boundary AP | mAP |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Previous epoch 42 | 48.97 | 52.99 | 67.77 | 56.58 |
| Updated epoch 38, after key remapping | 47.05 | 51.55 | 67.73 | 55.45 |
| Paper: vector-only, Table II | 68.6 | 63.0 | 68.8 | 66.8 |

The updated checkpoint initially produced **zero AP**. Loading diagnostics showed **17 missing and 17 unexpected keys**, all corresponding to this prefix mismatch:

```text
Checkpoint: pts_bbox_head.transformer.fusion_layer.*
Model:      pts_bbox_head.transformer.vector_fusion_layer.*
```

After renaming only this prefix, strict loading passed with matching tensor shapes and no missing or unexpected keys. **No weight values were changed.** However, the resulting mAP was **55.45**, still below the reported **66.8**.

I have attached my [reproduction config](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33198504/reproduce__maptrv2_nusc_r50_24ep_vector.py). Compared with the official vector config at `6616411`, only the dataset/prior paths and `workers_per_gpu` differ.

```text
divider: 0.47051751613616943
ped_crossing: 0.5155406594276428
boundary: 0.6773195068041483
map: 0.5544592274559869
```

Could you please clarify:

1. Is the prefix remapping sufficient, or does the epoch-38 checkpoint require a different code revision or model configuration?
2. Are the released `nuscenes_trainval_hdmap.pkl` and `nuscenes_trainval_sdmap.pkl` the intended priors for reproducing 66.8 mAP, or is there another preprocessing/configuration step I should follow?
3. Could you share the exact evaluation command, configuration, and code revision used to obtain approximately 66.8 mAP with this checkpoint?

Thank you for your time and support.
